title: •Krayt Dragon Howl
caption: •Krayt Dragon Howl (V)
game_text:
USED: If Obi-Wan on table, activate up to 3 Force.
STARTING: ▼ Obi-Wan (regardless of Objective deployment restrictions) and his matching weapon to a Tatooine site. When you draw your starting hand, draw three cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in hand.
lore: Using Jedi skill, Obi-Wan Kenobi imitated perfectly the mournful howl of the dangerous krayt dragon to scare Tusken Raiders away from Luke Skywalker.
